entities.name: Maria do Carmo Medina
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria do Carmo Medina was a Portuguese-born Angolan human rights defender, pro-Angola independence campaigner, academic, and the first female judge of Luanda Court of Appeal in Angola.
